tools.invoice-nup.step_2: 选择 2 合 1 或 4 合 1，并按需调整页边距和间距。
tools.invoice-nup.step_3: 生成并下载可打印的 A4 PDF。

tools.invoice-nup.faq_3_q: 发票会上传到服务器吗？
tools.invoice-nup.faq_3_a: 不会。所有处理都在浏览器本地完成，文件不会离开您的设备。

privacy.title: 隐私政策
privacy.intro: PDF 工具箱是纯前端应用。所有 PDF 处理都在您的浏览器中完成，文件不会上传到任何服务器。
privacy.no_upload_text: 合并、拆分、压缩、旋转等 PDF 操作均通过 JavaScript 和 Web Worker 在浏览器本地执行。我们没有文件上传接口，也无法访问您的文档。
privacy.data_collected_text: 我们不收集个人数据。仅在您的设备本地保存以下偏好：
privacy.data_locale: 首选语言和主题（保存在 localStorage 中）
privacy.cookies_text: 本站不使用广告或分析 Cookie，仅使用：
privacy.cookies_locale: 在设备本地保存语言和主题偏好。
privacy.third_party_text: 本站包含 i41 工具生态、上游 GitHub 和标准文档等外部链接。只有在您主动点击时才会访问相应网站。
privacy.children_text: 本站不收集任何用户个人信息。
privacy.changes_text: 本政策如有更新，将在此页面公布。
privacy.contact_text: 如有隐私问题，请通过项目的 GitHub 仓库反馈。

tools.merge-pdf.how_text: Combine multiple PDF documents into one file directly in your browser. No upload needed — your files stay on your device.
tools.merge-pdf.step_1: Select or drag and drop multiple PDF files.
tools.merge-pdf.step_2: Arrange files in the desired order.
tools.merge-pdf.step_3: Click Merge PDF and download the result.
tools.merge-pdf.faq_1_q: Is there a limit on how many PDFs I can merge?
tools.merge-pdf.faq_1_a: No hard limit. Since processing happens in your browser, it depends on your device's memory. Most devices handle dozens of files easily.
tools.merge-pdf.faq_2_q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
tools.merge-pdf.faq_2_a: No. All processing happens locally in your browser. Your files never leave your device.
tools.merge-pdf.faq_3_q: Can I change the order of pages?
tools.merge-pdf.faq_3_a: Yes. You can reorder the files before merging. For page-level control, use the Organize PDF tool.
tools.split-pdf.how_text: Extract specific pages or split a PDF into multiple documents. Everything runs in your browser.
tools.split-pdf.step_2: Choose to split all pages or select a range.
tools.split-pdf.step_3: Click Split PDF and download the results.
tools.split-pdf.faq_1_a: Yes. Use range mode and enter page numbers like 1-3, 5, 7-9.
tools.split-pdf.faq_2_q: What format are the output files?
tools.split-pdf.faq_2_a: Each split produces a standard PDF file. You can download them individually or as a ZIP.
tools.compress-pdf.how_text: Reduce PDF file size while maintaining visual quality. Choose from three compression levels.
tools.compress-pdf.step_2: Select a compression level (low, medium, or high).
tools.compress-pdf.step_3: Click Compress PDF and download the smaller file.
tools.compress-pdf.faq_1_q: How much can I reduce the file size?
tools.compress-pdf.faq_1_a: It depends on the content. Image-heavy PDFs can be reduced by 50-80%. Text-only PDFs may see smaller reductions.
tools.compress-pdf.faq_2_a: Low compression preserves near-original quality. High compression reduces quality more but achieves smaller file sizes.
tools.rotate-pdf.how_text: Rotate all pages of a PDF by 90°, 180°, or 270°. Perfect for fixing scanned documents.
tools.rotate-pdf.faq_1_a: Currently, rotation applies to all pages. For individual page control, use the Organize tool to remove unwanted pages.
tools.watermark-pdf.how_title: How to Add a Watermark to PDF
tools.watermark-pdf.how_text: Add text or image watermarks to your PDF documents. Customize position, opacity, size, and rotation.
tools.watermark-pdf.step_2: Choose text or image watermark and customize options.
tools.watermark-pdf.step_3: Position the watermark on the preview and click Add Watermark.
tools.watermark-pdf.faq_1_q: Can I use an image as watermark?
tools.watermark-pdf.faq_1_a: Yes. You can upload a PNG or JPG image and adjust its size, opacity, and position.
tools.pdf-to-jpg.how_title: How to Convert PDF to JPG
tools.pdf-to-jpg.how_text: Convert each page of a PDF into a high-quality JPG image. Adjust quality settings to balance size and clarity.
tools.pdf-to-jpg.step_3: Click Convert to JPG and download images.
tools.pdf-to-jpg.faq_1_a: 80% offers a good balance. Use 100% for maximum quality or lower values for smaller files.
tools.jpg-to-pdf.how_title: How to Convert Images to PDF
tools.jpg-to-pdf.how_text: Convert JPG, PNG, or WebP images into a PDF document. Set orientation and margins.
tools.jpg-to-pdf.step_3: Click Convert to PDF and download.
tools.jpg-to-pdf.faq_1_a: JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WebP images are supported.
tools.protect-pdf.how_title: How to Password Protect a PDF
tools.protect-pdf.how_text: Add password protection to your PDF files. Set user and owner passwords with custom permissions.
tools.protect-pdf.step_3: Click Protect PDF and download the secured file.
tools.protect-pdf.faq_1_q: What is the difference between user and owner password?
tools.protect-pdf.faq_1_a: The user password is needed to open the file. The owner password controls permissions like printing and copying.
tools.unlock-pdf.how_text: Remove password protection from a PDF file. You need to know the current password.
tools.unlock-pdf.step_3: Click Unlock PDF and download the unprotected file.
tools.unlock-pdf.faq_1_q: Can I unlock a PDF without the password?
tools.unlock-pdf.faq_1_a: No. You need to provide the correct password to remove protection.
tools.organize-pdf.how_text: Reorder, delete, or duplicate pages in your PDF using a visual drag-and-drop interface.
tools.organize-pdf.step_2: Drag pages to reorder. Use buttons to duplicate or delete.
tools.organize-pdf.faq_1_a: Yes. Click the duplicate button on any page thumbnail to create a copy.
tools.crop-pdf.how_text: Trim margins or crop PDF pages to a specific area. Adjust crop values for each side.
tools.crop-pdf.step_2: Adjust the crop area on the preview.
tools.pdf-to-png.how_title: How to Convert PDF to PNG
tools.pdf-to-png.how_text: Convert PDF pages to high-quality PNG images with optional transparent background.
tools.pdf-to-png.step_3: Click Convert to PNG and download.
tools.redact-pdf.how_text: Permanently black out sensitive content in your PDF. Redacted areas cannot be recovered.
tools.redact-pdf.step_2: Draw rectangles over content to redact.
tools.redact-pdf.faq_1_a: Yes. Redacted content is permanently removed and cannot be recovered.
tools.edit-pdf.how_text: Add text, shapes, and freehand drawings to your PDF documents.
tools.edit-pdf.step_2: Add text blocks, rectangles, or draw freehand.
tools.sign-pdf.how_text: Add your signature to PDF documents. Draw a signature or upload a signature image.
tools.sign-pdf.step_2: Draw your signature or upload an image.
tools.sign-pdf.step_3: Position the signature and click Apply Signature.
tools.sign-pdf.faq_1_q: Is this a legally binding digital signature?
tools.sign-pdf.faq_1_a: This adds a visual signature to the document. For legally binding digital signatures (PAdES/P7M), a qualified certificate is required.
tools.extract-images.how_title: How to Extract Images from PDF
tools.extract-images.how_text: Extract all embedded images from a PDF document as individual PNG files.
tools.extract-images.step_3: Download individual images or all as a ZIP.
tools.grayscale-pdf.how_title: How to Convert PDF to Grayscale
tools.grayscale-pdf.how_text: Convert a color PDF to black and white. Useful for printing or reducing visual complexity.
tools.resize-pdf.how_text: Change the page size of your PDF to A4, A3, Letter, or Legal format.
tools.page-numbers.how_title: How to Add Page Numbers to PDF
tools.page-numbers.how_text: Add page numbers to your PDF documents. Choose position and format.
tools.page-numbers.step_3: Click Add Page Numbers and download.
tools.header-footer.how_title: How to Add Header and Footer to PDF
tools.header-footer.how_text: Add custom header and footer text to your PDF. Use placeholders for page numbers.
tools.header-footer.step_3: Click Apply Header & Footer and download.
tools.flatten-pdf.how_text: Flatten form fields and annotations into static content. Useful before sharing or archiving.
tools.flatten-pdf.step_1: Upload a PDF file with form fields.
tools.flatten-pdf.faq_1_a: It converts interactive form fields and annotations into static page content that can no longer be edited.
tools.pdf-to-text.how_title: How to Extract Text from PDF
tools.pdf-to-text.how_text: Extract all text content from a PDF document and save it as a plain text file.
tools.pdf-to-text.faq_1_q: Does this work with scanned PDFs?
tools.pdf-to-text.faq_1_a: No. This extracts embedded text only. Scanned documents contain images and would require OCR.

tools.markdown-to-pdf.how_title: How to Convert Markdown to PDF
tools.markdown-to-pdf.how_text: Write or paste your Markdown text and convert it into a professionally formatted PDF document, entirely in your browser.
tools.markdown-to-pdf.step_1: Write or paste your Markdown content in the text area.
tools.markdown-to-pdf.step_2: Preview the supported formatting: headings, bold, italic, lists, code blocks.
tools.markdown-to-pdf.step_3: Click Generate PDF and download your document.
tools.markdown-to-pdf.faq_1_a: Headings (# to ###), bold (**text**), italic (*text*), bullet lists (- item), numbered lists (1. item), code blocks (```), and horizontal rules (---).
tools.markdown-to-pdf.faq_2_a: No. Everything happens locally in your browser. Your text is never sent to any server.
tools.markdown-to-pdf.faq_3_a: The generated PDF uses A4 page size with standard margins.
tools.edit-metadata.name: 编辑元数据
tools.edit-metadata.description: 在浏览器本地完成编辑元数据，文件无需上传。
tools.edit-metadata.how_text: View and update the metadata fields of your PDF documents — title, author, subject, keywords, and more.
tools.edit-metadata.step_3: Edit the fields you want to change.
tools.edit-metadata.step_4: Click Save Metadata and download the updated file.
tools.edit-metadata.faq_1_a: PDF metadata includes information such as the document title, author, subject, keywords, creator application, and producer. It is embedded in the file and used by search engines and file managers.
tools.edit-metadata.faq_2_a: Yes. Simply clear all fields and save. The metadata will be set to empty values.
tools.edit-metadata.faq_3_q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
tools.edit-metadata.faq_3_a: No. All processing happens locally in your browser. Your files never leave your device.
tools.pdf-to-webp.name: PDF 转 WebP
tools.pdf-to-webp.description: 在浏览器本地完成PDF 转 WebP，文件无需上传。
tools.pdf-to-webp.how_title: How to Convert PDF to WebP
tools.pdf-to-webp.how_text: Convert each page of a PDF into a WebP image. WebP offers better compression than JPG and PNG.
tools.pdf-to-webp.step_3: Click Convert to WebP and download images.
tools.pdf-to-webp.faq_1_q: Why use WebP instead of JPG?
tools.pdf-to-webp.faq_1_a: WebP images are typically 25-34% smaller than JPG at the same quality, making them ideal for web use.
tools.nup-pdf.name: 多页合一
tools.nup-pdf.description: 在浏览器本地完成多页合一，文件无需上传。
tools.nup-pdf.how_text: Combine multiple PDF pages onto each sheet. Great for saving paper when printing.
tools.nup-pdf.step_3: Click Apply N-Up Layout and download.
tools.nup-pdf.faq_1_a: N-Up means placing multiple pages on a single sheet. For example, 4-up prints four pages on one sheet.

tools.add-blank-page.description: 在浏览器本地完成添加空白页，文件无需上传。
tools.add-blank-page.how_title: How to Add a Blank Page to PDF
tools.add-blank-page.how_text: Insert a blank page at the start or end of your PDF document.
tools.add-blank-page.step_2: Choose where to insert the blank page.
tools.add-blank-page.step_3: Click Add Blank Page and download.
tools.remove-blank-pages.name: 删除空白页
tools.remove-blank-pages.description: 在浏览器本地完成删除空白页，文件无需上传。
tools.remove-blank-pages.how_title: How to Remove Blank Pages from PDF
tools.remove-blank-pages.how_text: Automatically scans your PDF and removes pages that are blank or nearly blank.
tools.remove-blank-pages.faq_1_a: Each page is rendered and analyzed. If 99.5% or more of the pixels are white, the page is considered blank.
tools.ocr-pdf.name: OCR 识别 PDF
tools.ocr-pdf.description: 在浏览器本地完成OCR 识别 PDF，文件无需上传。
tool.ocr.hint: OCR works best on scanned documents with clear text. Processing may take a few minutes.
tools.ocr-pdf.how_text: Run optical character recognition on scanned PDF pages to make the text searchable and copyable.
tools.ocr-pdf.step_3: Click Run OCR and download the searchable PDF.
tools.ocr-pdf.faq_1_q: Does OCR work on handwritten text?
tools.ocr-pdf.faq_1_a: OCR works best on printed text. Handwritten text may not be recognized accurately.
tools.compare-pdf.name: 比较 PDF
tools.compare-pdf.description: 在浏览器本地完成比较 PDF，文件无需上传。
tools.compare-pdf.how_text: Upload two PDF files to see them side by side with visual differences highlighted in red.
tools.compare-pdf.faq_1_a: Pages are rendered side by side. Pixels that differ between the two documents are highlighted in red on the right side.

tools.text-to-pdf.step_1: Type or paste your text in the text area.

tools.reverse-pages.how_text: Flip the page order of your PDF so the last page becomes the first.
tools.invert-colors.name: 反转颜色
tools.invert-colors.description: 在浏览器本地完成反转颜色，文件无需上传。
tools.invert-colors.how_text: Create a color-negative version of your PDF. Useful for dark mode reading or design effects.
tools.repair-pdf.name: 修复 PDF
tools.repair-pdf.description: 在浏览器本地完成修复 PDF，文件无需上传。
tools.repair-pdf.how_text: Try to recover and fix a corrupted PDF by re-parsing and re-saving the document structure.
tools.repair-pdf.faq_1_a: Not always. The tool can fix many common issues, but severely damaged files may not be recoverable.
tools.pdf-to-epub.name: PDF 转 EPUB
tools.pdf-to-epub.description: 在浏览器本地完成PDF 转 EPUB，文件无需上传。
tools.pdf-to-epub.how_title: How to Convert PDF to EPUB
tools.pdf-to-epub.how_text: Extract text from your PDF and package it into an EPUB ebook format for e-readers.
tools.pdf-to-epub.faq_1_q: Does this work with scanned PDFs?
tools.pdf-to-epub.faq_1_a: No. This tool extracts embedded text. Scanned PDFs need OCR first to make the text available.
tools.booklet-pdf.name: PDF 小册子
tools.booklet-pdf.description: 在浏览器本地完成PDF 小册子，文件无需上传。
tools.booklet-pdf.how_title: How to Create a PDF Booklet
tools.booklet-pdf.how_text: Rearrange your PDF pages so you can print double-sided, fold and staple to make a booklet.
tools.booklet-pdf.step_3: Download the rearranged PDF and print double-sided.
tools.booklet-pdf.faq_1_q: How does booklet page ordering work?
tools.booklet-pdf.faq_1_a: Pages are rearranged so that when printed on both sides and folded in half, they form a booklet. The tool automatically pads to a multiple of 4 pages if needed.
tools.booklet-pdf.faq_2_q: Do I need a special printer?
tools.booklet-pdf.faq_2_a: You need a printer that supports double-sided (duplex) printing. Print the resulting PDF double-sided, then fold and staple.
tools.booklet-pdf.faq_3_q: What if my PDF has an odd number of pages?
tools.booklet-pdf.faq_3_a: The tool automatically adds blank pages to make the total a multiple of 4, which is required for booklet layout.
tools.add-qr-code.name: 添加二维码
tools.add-qr-code.description: 在浏览器本地完成添加二维码，文件无需上传。
tools.add-qr-code.how_title: How to Add a QR Code to a PDF
tools.add-qr-code.how_text: Type any text or URL to generate a QR code, drag it to the desired position on your PDF page, then export.
tools.add-qr-code.step_2: Enter text or a URL to generate the QR code.
tools.add-qr-code.step_3: Position the QR code on the page and click Add QR Code.
tools.add-qr-code.faq_1_q: What can I encode in the QR code?
tools.add-qr-code.faq_1_a: Any text, URL, email address, phone number, or other data up to 2000 characters. The QR code is generated with medium error correction.
tools.add-qr-code.faq_2_q: Can I choose which page the QR code goes on?
tools.add-qr-code.faq_2_a: Yes. Use the page navigation arrows to select the target page, then drag the QR code to position it.
tools.add-qr-code.faq_3_q: Is the QR code permanently embedded?
tools.add-qr-code.faq_3_a: Yes. The QR code is embedded as a PNG image in the PDF and will appear when printed or viewed in any PDF reader.

tools.check-accessibility.name: 无障碍检查
tools.check-accessibility.description: 在浏览器本地完成无障碍检查，文件无需上传。
tools.check-accessibility.how_text: Upload a PDF to get a detailed accessibility report covering 10 criteria including tagging, document language, font embedding, alt text on images, and form field labels.
tools.check-accessibility.step_3: Review the accessibility report in your browser.
tools.check-accessibility.faq_1_a: A tagged PDF contains a structure tree that screen readers use to determine reading order and element roles (headings, paragraphs, lists, figures). Without tags, assistive technologies cannot reliably interpret the document.
tools.check-accessibility.faq_2_q: Can this tool fix accessibility issues?
tools.check-accessibility.faq_2_a: No. This tool only reports issues. Fixing them requires editing the PDF source or using an authoring tool that supports accessibility features.
tools.check-accessibility.faq_3_q: Does the checker upload my file?
tools.check-accessibility.faq_3_a: No. All analysis runs entirely in your browser. Your file never leaves your device.
tools.pdf-to-markdown.name: PDF 转 Markdown
tools.pdf-to-markdown.description: 在浏览器本地完成PDF 转 Markdown，文件无需上传。
tools.pdf-to-markdown.how_title: How to Convert PDF to Markdown
tools.pdf-to-markdown.how_text: Upload a PDF to extract its text content as clean Markdown. The converter detects headings by font size, preserves bold and italic formatting, and recognizes bullet and numbered lists.
tools.pdf-to-markdown.faq_1_a: No. This tool extracts text content only. Images are not included in the Markdown output.
tools.pdf-to-markdown.faq_2_a: The converter analyzes font sizes and bold styling. Text that is bold and shorter than 80 characters is treated as a heading.
tools.pdf-to-markdown.faq_3_a: No. All conversion runs entirely in your browser. Your file never leaves your device.
